headline: Slifer Deck: The Cards You Need
title: Slifer the Sky Dragon Deck | Best Support Cards | Yu-Gi-Oh Master Duel and TCG
video_script: Here is how to build a Slifer the Sky Dragon deck, and the cards that make it work. Slifer was Yugi's Egyptian God in Battle City. The core is Slifer itself. It gains one thousand attack and defense for each card in your hand, so this deck wants a big hand. The Revived Sky God brings Slifer back from your Graveyard, then both players draw until they hold six cards. Six cards in hand means six thousand attack. Thunderforce Attack works while you control Slifer. It destroys as many face-up monsters your opponent controls as possible, and in your Main Phase you draw for each one sent to their Graveyard. Soul Crossing Tribute Summons a Divine-Beast, and you can use your opponent's monsters as the Tributes. After that, you can only activate one card or effect per turn until the end of the next turn. Divine Evolution gives Slifer one thousand more attack and defense, its effects cannot be negated, and when it attacks, your opponent must send one of their monsters to the Graveyard. Ultimate Divine-Beast is a Trap. When your opponent attacks, discard a Spell or Trap to Special Summon a Divine-Beast from your Graveyard in Defense Position, and the attack goes to it. For Tributes, Ra's Disciple summons up to two more copies from your hand or Deck, and they can only be Tributed for the Egyptian Gods. Which card would you add to this deck? Comment below!
